Dear

In reference to registration of SSA/Loan agreement with SBP regarding subject account, you are requested to
further response the given queries for onward submission to our Compliance Team. (Matter is Urgent)

1. Specific/special permission letters issued by SBP on the basis of which branch remitted
dividend/disinvestments’ proceeds favoring non-resident investor(s).
2. Business profile of non-resident investor containing ownership, organization/group, locations, markets and
products.
3.

Promoters’/ Directors’ names, addresses, national ID/passport numbers & country of domicile(abroad)

4.

Memorandum & Articles of Association or equivalent registered with the relevant Authority in abroad

5.

Pattern of Shareholders (name, national identity number & shares held) or equivalent.

6.

Related Party details including beneficial ownership with aforementioned documents.

7.

Business profile containing ownership, organization / group. Location, markets and products.

8.

Board of Investment Registration Letter

9.

Copy of Certificate of holding deposits

10. Copy of Exchange Entitlement Certificate (EEC)
11. Copy of documents pertaining to Beneficial Owner
